name: Claw Agent
description: Lets the Claw OS agent operate this browser through a permission-gated Native Messaging bridge.
_trust_model_comment: host_permissions:<all_urls> is intentional for the local-trust agent: the extension can read/write any tab the user has open. Access is gated by the cos kernel capability system (the native host enforces per-verb caps), not by the manifest. Operators who want to narrow the trust surface SHOULD edit host_permissions to an explicit allowlist of origins before deploying.
